title: Dynamics 365 Sales: sales skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork
summary: Hold: the spending-policy routes omit the Identity policy-type choice, and the Sales access route starts inside administrator settings without explaining how to open them. The roadmap facts, Sales licence requirements and usage-based billing are supported; several governance qualifications need clarification. Instruction-like text in an MCP documentation sample was treated as source material, not followed.
